newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Over 100 dead or wounded in Xinjiang Moslem riot before Chinese lunar new year.
Taiwan holiday bumper-to-bumper traffic lasts 36 hours.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Two Taiwan tourist groups encounter air hijacking in mainland China.
U.S. President Bill Clinton, Vice-Presidnet Al Gore attend overseas Chinese New Year party.
LIBERTY TIMES - Dalai Lama's visit to Taiwan will help improve relations between Taiwan and Tibet, interior minister of exiled Tibetan government says.
President Clinton urges overseas Chinese to make contributions to U.S. domocracy.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan stock market seen bullish in new lunar Year of the Ox.
Central bank further eases ban on currency swaps.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Analysts expect Taiwan stock index to rise after Chinese new year holiday.
